function.arguments: {"message":"Hi! When an import finishes, the main screen only shows a summary. arguments.message: Hi! When an import finishes, the main screen only shows a summary. To see which rows failed and why, go to Settings → Data → Import history, click on the run you just completed, and you’ll see a per‑row list with a reason for each failure. Once you’ve fixed the problematic rows, you can re‑run the import on just those rows – this will update the existing records instead of re‑processing the ones that already succeeded. Let me know if you need help locating the history or anything else!
